chunks: Then (fear) Allāh, in your own self;
for, by Allāh, you are not being shown anything as if you are blind or being apprised of anything as if you are ignorant. The ways are clear while the banners of faith are fixed.

You should know that among the creatures of Allāh, the most distinguished person before Allāh is the just Imām who has been guided (by Allāh) and guides others. So, he stands by the recognized ways of the Prophet’s behaviour and destroys unrecognized innovations.
The (Prophet’s) ways are clear and they have signs,
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of the Just Imam according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this address to Caliph Uthman, Imam Ali underscores the sufficiency of divine guidance by asserting that the path is clear and religious markers are established, implying that failure lies in self-neglect rather than lack of knowledge. He elevates the Just Imam as the pinnacle of worship, defined by his role in reviving known Sunnah and extinguishing unknown Bid'ah, a concept central to Shia political theology regarding the Imam's authority to preserve and interpret the faith.
